body: ### Features - **Dynamic Instrumentation:** Add an evaluation time budget [#10156](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10156) - **Feature Flags:** Add privacy-protected flag evaluation telemetry [#10464](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10464) - **LLM Observability:** Add BaseEvaluator support for Experiments [#9848](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9848) - **LLM Observability:** Add remote evaluators [#10487](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10487) - **OpenTelemetry:** Add OTel consistent probability sampling state to spans exported through OTLP [#10189](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10189) - **OpenTelemetry:** Otel sampling support in distributed tracing [#10117](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10117) ### Fixes - **aws-sdk:** Handle region provider rejections [#10583](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10583) - **Dynamic Instrumentation:** Bound pause duration telemetry while the application is busy [#10607](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10607) - **Dynamic Instrumentation:** Classify worker failures in telemetry [#10393](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10393) - **Dynamic Instrumentation:** Drop probe results that stay over the size cap [#10345](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10345) - **Dynamic Instrumentation:** Redact sensitive identifiers in log templates and capture expressions [#10612](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10612) - **General:** Restore legacy RC capability bits [#10573](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10573) - **LLM Observability:** Don't corrupt literal "\u" sequences when encoding payloads [#10609](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10609) - **LLM Observability:** Keep LLMObs tracing after an aborted stream [#10577](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10577) - **LLM Observability:** Preserve structured experiment output [#10472](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10472) - **LLM Observability:** Properly record `runtimeContext` in newer v7 versions [#10629](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10629) - **OpenTelemetry:** Return non-function targets unchanged from ContextManager.bind() [#10544](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10544) ### Internal (CI, Testing, Benchmarking) - **AppSec:** Update native-appsec to 11.0.3 [#10625](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10625) - **Feature Flags:** Shorten evaluation workloads [#10588](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10588) - **Feature Flags:** Verify bundled provider behavior and align test versions [#10545](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10545) - **General:** Shorten replacement injection [#10587](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10587) - **General:** Update one-pipeline version [#10610](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10610) - **postgres:** Remove identity hooks [#10649](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10649) - **supabase:** Remove identity hooks [#10511](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10511) ### Contributors [](https://github.com/BridgeAR) [](https://github.com/codex) [](https://github.com/IlyasShabi) [](https://github.com/jessicagamio) [](https://github.com/mehulsonowal) [](https://github.com/mtoffl01) [](https://github.com/pabloerhard) [](https://github.com/rachelyangdog) [](https://github.com/rochdev) [](https://github.com/sabrenner) [](https://github.com/vjfridge) [](https://github.com/vpellan) [](https://github.com/watson)
